title: Skill
description: A reusable robot skill — the atomic unit of behavior in BotverseX. This schema is aligned with apps/api/app/data/skills_seed.json and is the BotClaw v0.9 source of truth for skill registry entries.

verb.description: Atomic action verb: grasp, place, pour, push, reach, wave, look-at, etc. Verb is the primary taxonomy axis; object/target lives in params.

params.description: Runtime parameter values supplied by a user or workflow instance. Registry entries define their editable form via params_schema.

params_schema.description: UI and API validation schema for skill parameters. This intentionally mirrors the file-backed registry used by apps/api/app/data/skills_seed.json.

key.description: Stable parameter key used in params payloads.

type.description: Basic scalar type supported by the current API validator.

default.description: Default value used by UI forms and install flows.

min.description: Minimum allowed value for number parameters.

max.description: Maximum allowed value for number parameters.

robot_type.description: Primary hardware target: 'so101', 'reachy_mini', 'openclaw', 'generic'. A skill may support multiple types via compatible_types.

compatible_types.description: Additional robot_type values this skill can run on (cross-hardware portability).

joint_count.description: Expected degrees of freedom for this skill. 6 for SO-101, 7+2 for Reachy Mini head+antennas.

train_backend.description: Preferred training backend. 'local' = on-device MLP/custom, 'qualia' = Qualia Studio API (ACT, SmolVLA, Pi0).

hf_model_id.description: Optional HuggingFace model repo ID for pre-trained checkpoint, e.g. 'botversex/grasp-generic-act-v1'.

hf_dataset_id.description: Optional HuggingFace dataset repo ID, e.g. 'botversex/so101-grasp-20episodes'.

min_episodes.description: Minimum training episodes recommended (e.g. 20 for ACT, 50 for SmolVLA).

episode_duration_s.description: Recommended per-episode recording duration in seconds. 30 = single action, 60 = two actions.

compatibility.description: Optional engineering-grade compatibility metadata. v0.9 keeps this optional; v1.0 may require success_rate by runtime.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this skill does.
